title: cleyera obscurinervia
intro: Cleyera obscurinervia, commonly known as the dark-veined cleyera or black cleyera, is a plant species in the family Theaceae. It is a type of evergreen shrub or small tree native to southeastern China. The dark-veined cleyera has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cleyera obscurinervia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
